data.description: Azure DevOps is a cloud-based service for managing software development projects. The Azure DevOps FortiSOAR connector integrates with Azure DevOps to automate the management of repositories, pipelines, work items, and more within FortiSOAR, enabling streamlined DevOps workflows and incident response.
